note: What has changed about one unit. A flag byte says which groups of values follow, and each group that follows says which of its values it holds and carries them as a run of bytes. The groups follow in a fixed order that is not the order of the flags: the last flag's values come before the one before it, and the rest run in flag order. spec/replication.md says what settles the reading of a run, and records what a champion's groups carry.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client takes only groups 0 to 4.
